title: DriftRuleDefinition
description: Explicit JSON Schema defining a deterministic drift validation rule.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the drift rule (e.g. RULE-PROD-DEBUG).

name.description: Short human-readable title of the rule.

target_environment.description: Environment where this policy is actively enforced.

category.description: Configuration pillar evaluated by this rule.

item_key.description: Configuration key targeted (e.g. DEBUG, DATABASE_HOST, replicas).

severity.description: Assigned severity if a discrepancy violates this rule.

forbidden_indicators.description: Substrings or hostnames forbidden in this environment (e.g. ['dev-db', 'localhost']).

expected_value.description: Canonical expected value (can be boolean, string, number, or object).

reason.description: Plain-English architectural explanation of why this drift is hazardous.

recommendation.description: Actionable instructions for the developer to remediate the drift.
